description.en-US: The older English translation of both books of Louis of Granada's Guía de pecadores, in the Philadelphia edition of 1844: Book I (the exhortation to virtue, in three parts of 10, 13 and 6 chapters) and Book II (the doctrine of virtue, in two parts of 11 and 10 chapters). It is a different translation from McKenna's, so it is its own book. Numbered paragraphs are kept.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa mais antiga (Filadélfia, 1844) dos dois livros do Guía de pecadores de Luís de Granada.

en-US.translator: anonymous, "translated from the Spanish" (Philadelphia: Henry McGrath, 1844)

sources.edition: The Sinner's Guide, in two books, by the Rev. F. Lewis of Granada, translated from the Spanish, Philadelphia: Henry McGrath, 1844 (the older English translation, a second witness beside McKenna's of 1883). Internet Archive scan sinnersguideintw00luisuoft.
sources.description: Internet Archive OCR, split at the 50 chapter headings; running heads and page numbers are dropped and line-break hyphens joined. The title pages, the translator's preface, the tables of contents and the index are not included; isolated recognition slips remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Published 1844, before 1930; public domain in the US.
